## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).


## Project 2

```{r}
library(httr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r}
#data cleaning
pokemon_data <- tibble(
  name = character(1351),
  height = numeric(1351),
  weight = numeric(1351),
  type1 = character(1351),
  type2 = character(1351),
  abilities = character(1351),
  hp = numeric(1351),
  atk = numeric(1351),
  def = numeric(1351),
  spatk = numeric(1351),
  spdef = numeric(1351),
  spd = numeric(1351),
  bst = numeric(1351)
)

for (i in 1:10) {

  url <- str_c("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/", i)

  pokemon_response <- GET(url)
  details <- content(pokemon_response, "parsed")
  
 pokemon_data$type1[i] <- details$types[[1]]$type$name
 
 if(length(details$types) >= 2)
   {pokemon_data$type2[i] <- details$types[[2]]$type$name}
 else
   {pokemon_data$type2[i] <- NA}

  pokemon_data$name[i] <- details$name
  pokemon_data$height[i] <- details$height
  pokemon_data$weight[i] <- details$weight
  pokemon_data$abilities[i] <- details$abilities
  #can maybe put in for loop
  pokemon_data$hp[i] <- details$stats[[1]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$atk[i] <- details$stats[[2]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$def[i] <- details$stats[[3]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spatk[i] <- details$stats[[4]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spdef[i] <- details$stats[[5]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$spd[i] <- details$stats[[6]]$base_stat
  pokemon_data$bst[i] <- pokemon_data$hp[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$atk[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$def[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spatk[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spdef[i][[1]] + pokemon_data$spd[i][[1]]
}

#pokemon_data <- pokemon_data |>
  #mutate(total = rowSums(across(col(7:12))), na.rm = TRUE))


pokemon_data

```
